plan: To preserve capital, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.
We will also exit high-beta AI/Software names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to reduce risk.
QQQI will be trimmed to 20% to cure the concentration breach.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for capital preservation, targeting a modest ~1.5%/month. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and high-beta names, but also limits upside potential. Expect lower drawdowns.

plan: We will trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to reduce overall leverage and cure the mandate breach.
High-beta AI/Software names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) will also be trimmed to reduce concentration.
QQQI will be trimmed to 25% to cure the concentration breach.
A new position in OXY will be initiated, based on its strong scanner setup, to diversify and add quality.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting around ~2.5%/month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality setup. Expect moderate drawdowns with balanced growth potential.

plan: QQQI will be trimmed to 25% to cure the concentration breach, freeing up capital for higher growth.
We will add to existing leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) and high-beta AI/Software names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) to increase growth potential.
A new position in OXY will be initiated at 6% based on its strong scanner setup.
This strategy leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth, adhering to strict stop discipline.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-beta names, which amplifies both upside and drawdown. Be aware of daily decay and rebalancing effects on leveraged ETFs, and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: To prioritize income, we will sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) to zero.
High-beta AI/Software names (METU, MSFU, PLTU) will also be sold to near zero.
QQQI will be increased to 30% to boost monthly distributions and cure the concentration breach.
This plan focuses on stable income and low drawdown, treating the book as cash-like.
income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting around ~1%/month. It significantly reduces growth-oriented and leveraged positions to prioritize steady monthly distributions. While aiming for low drawdown, NAV can still fall in a selloff, and distributions are variable, not guaranteed.
